compiled_state.description: Settle the unsettled trust-model decisions the vaquita escalation surfaced, before any code-review-reuse implementation. Decide: (a) the identity notion for reuse (confirm env_id/principal-under-own-key, or switch to key-fingerprint / pinned trusted-environment identity); (b) the NEW code-review op-cert kind slot + its policy entry (only plan-review and completion-verifier exist today); (c) the authenticated diff/ref MATERIAL fingerprint a code-review attestation binds (e.g. {ticket_id, base..head range, diff content hash, merged_log_commit}) — none exists today; (d) how diff-oriented review-code binds to a ticket (via the change's rebar-ticket: trailer?) and composes with the ADR 0088 unsigned session:<id> convergence artifact; (e) whether a REUSED code-review attestation may satisfy the Gerrit LLM-Review +1 merge vote and across which environments (ADR 0013/0020 trust boundary). Output: an accepted ADR. Blocks the code-review producer/consumer story.
compiled_state.title: ADR: attestation reuse — identity scope + code-review op-cert kind + merge-vote trust boundary
